entities.name: Jiří Kormaník
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jiří Kormaník was a Czech amateur wrestler. Born in Romania, he competed for Czechoslovakia at the 1960, 1964 and 1968 Olympics in Greco-Roman wrestling and won a silver medal in 1964.
